name: Tomatoes
summary: This painting of tomatoes is done on English 'Whatman' paper, specially imported for its quality. Unfamiliar flora and fauna were of great interest to British botanists in the 18th and 19th centuries, and such enthusiasm gradually filtered down to the general public.
